_comment: Companion services the forge builds beside the devcontainer and the devpod root deploys next to the workspace. Validated by the forge against its closed schema (app/internal/services/services.cue): a typo here is a red pull request naming this file. Defaults are left out on purpose -- dockerfile, protocol, interval -- so the services.json the forge publishes for a build visibly differs from this source: THAT file, with every default filled, is what an operator passes to the devpod root.
